findings.reason: the plan must either name the extension to `_commit_state_write` (accept a set of paths, an edit to its owner in ledger.py) or drop the no-extra-commit claim, which changes §3's write-path row and its done-when.
findings.text: §3 claims the record "is written into the committed store in that same state write, so it travels in the ledger commit the promotion already makes and no commit is added", but `_commit_state_write(project, subject, body, path, what)` stages and commits exactly one path (`git add -- <relative_path>`, `git commit --only ... -- <relative_path>`), and the review record's path (`docs/state/<project>/reviews/…json`) is not the run ledger row's path (`docs/state/<project>/crew.json`). One call cannot carry both, so the stated "no commit is added" is not achievable through the current signature
